title: Mercado y ofertas
description: Volumen de ofertas por mes y región, quién contrata, y lista de ofertas. Una oferta publicada en varias fuentes o ciudades cuenta una vez.

list.name: region
list.label: Región
list.query: Suiza : ch,España : es,Resto de Europa : eu,Otras / sin región : other

list.name: tier
list.label: Tipo de empresa
list.description: FAANG + Microsoft, otras big tech o el resto. Ver src/jobpipe/employers.py.

list.label: Rol
list.description: Familia de puesto, deducida del título.
list.query: SELECT role AS __value, CASE role WHEN 'product' THEN 'Producto y diseño' WHEN 'eng_management' THEN 'Gestión técnica' WHEN 'ml' THEN 'ML / IA' WHEN 'data' THEN 'Datos' WHEN 'devops' THEN 'DevOps / SRE / Plataforma' WHEN 'security' THEN 'Seguridad' WHEN 'mobile' THEN 'Móvil' WHEN 'qa' THEN 'QA / Test' WHEN 'embedded' THEN 'Embebido / Hardware' WHEN 'fullstack' THEN 'Full-stack' WHEN 'frontend' THEN 'Frontend' WHEN 'backend' THEN 'Backend' WHEN 'engineering' THEN 'Ingeniería (general)' WHEN 'other' THEN 'Otros (no técnicos)' ELSE role END AS __text FROM gold.jobs GROUP BY role ORDER BY count(*) DESC
list.definition: SELECT role AS __value, CASE role WHEN 'product' THEN 'Producto y diseño' WHEN 'eng_management' THEN 'Gestión técnica' WHEN 'ml' THEN 'ML / IA' WHEN 'data' THEN 'Datos' WHEN 'devops' THEN 'DevOps / SRE / Plataforma' WHEN 'security' THEN 'Seguridad' WHEN 'mobile' THEN 'Móvil' WHEN 'qa' THEN 'QA / Test' WHEN 'embedded' THEN 'Embebido / Hardware' WHEN 'fullstack' THEN 'Full-stack' WHEN 'frontend' THEN 'Frontend' WHEN 'backend' THEN 'Backend' WHEN 'engineering' THEN 'Ingeniería (general)' WHEN 'other' THEN 'Otros (no técnicos)' ELSE role END AS __text FROM gold.jobs GROUP BY role ORDER BY count(*) DESC

list.name: seniority
list.label: Nivel
list.description: Deducido del título. La mayoría de títulos no lo indican.
list.query: SELECT seniority AS __value, CASE seniority WHEN 'intern' THEN 'Prácticas / becario' WHEN 'head' THEN 'Head / dirección' WHEN 'lead' THEN 'Lead / staff / principal' WHEN 'senior' THEN 'Senior' WHEN 'junior' THEN 'Junior' WHEN 'mid' THEN 'Intermedio' WHEN 'unspecified' THEN 'Sin indicar' ELSE seniority END AS __text FROM gold.jobs GROUP BY seniority ORDER BY array_position(ARRAY['intern', 'head', 'lead', 'senior', 'junior', 'mid', 'unspecified'], seniority)
list.definition: SELECT seniority AS __value, CASE seniority WHEN 'intern' THEN 'Prácticas / becario' WHEN 'head' THEN 'Head / dirección' WHEN 'lead' THEN 'Lead / staff / principal' WHEN 'senior' THEN 'Senior' WHEN 'junior' THEN 'Junior' WHEN 'mid' THEN 'Intermedio' WHEN 'unspecified' THEN 'Sin indicar' ELSE seniority END AS __text FROM gold.jobs GROUP BY seniority ORDER BY array_position(ARRAY['intern', 'head', 'lead', 'senior', 'junior', 'mid', 'unspecified'], seniority)

list.name: company
list.label: Empresa
list.query: SELECT company FROM gold.jobs WHERE company IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC, 1 LIMIT 500
list.definition: SELECT company FROM gold.jobs WHERE company IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC, 1 LIMIT 500

list.definition: SELECT key AS __value, label AS __text FROM silver.technologies ORDER BY lower(label)

links.title: Añadir oferta
links.tooltip: Añadir una oferta a mano, p. ej. de Google

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) FROM gold.jobs WHERE last_seen > now() - interval '7 days' AND coalesce(nullif(regions, '{}'), '{other}') && ARRAY[$region]::text[]
  AND company_tier IN ($tier)
  AND ('__all' IN ($role) OR role IN ($role))
  AND ('__all' IN ($seniority) OR seniority IN ($seniority))
  AND ('__all' IN ($company) OR company IN ($company))

SELECT count(*) FROM gold.jobs WHERE posted_at > now() - interval '30 days' AND coalesce(nullif(regions, '{}'), '{other}') && ARRAY[$region]::text[]
  AND company_tier IN ($tier)
  AND ('__all' IN ($role) OR role IN ($role))
  AND ('__all' IN ($seniority) OR seniority IN ($seniority))
  AND ('__all' IN ($company) OR company IN ($company))

SELECT count(DISTINCT lower(company)) FROM gold.jobs WHERE last_seen > now() - interval '90 days' AND coalesce(nullif(regions, '{}'), '{other}') && ARRAY[$region]::text[]
  AND company_tier IN ($tier)
  AND ('__all' IN ($role) OR role IN ($role))
  AND ('__all' IN ($seniority) OR seniority IN ($seniority))
  AND ('__all' IN ($company) OR company IN ($company))

SELECT 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM gold.salaries s WHERE s.job_id = p.job_id AND NOT s.predicted)) / nullif(count(*), 0) FROM gold.jobs p WHERE coalesce(nullif(regions, '{}'), '{other}') && ARRAY[$region]::text[]
  AND company_tier IN ($tier)
  AND ('__all' IN ($role) OR role IN ($role))
  AND ('__all' IN ($seniority) OR seniority IN ($seniority))
  AND ('__all' IN ($company) OR company IN ($company))

panels.title: Ofertas publicadas por mes y región
panels.description: Fecha de publicación según la fuente; si no la da, la primera vez que se vio. HN aporta la historia desde 2011.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT month::timestamptz AS time, CASE region WHEN 'ch' THEN 'Suiza' WHEN 'es' THEN 'España' WHEN 'eu' THEN 'Resto de Europa' WHEN 'other' THEN 'Otras / sin región' ELSE region END AS metric, sum(postings) AS value
FROM gold.postings_monthly
WHERE $__timeFilter(month::timestamptz) AND region IN ($region) AND company_tier IN ($tier) AND ('__all' IN ($role) OR role IN ($role))
  AND ('__all' IN ($seniority) OR seniority IN ($seniority))
GROUP BY 1, region ORDER BY 1

SELECT company AS "Empresa", count(*) AS "Ofertas",
       to_char(max(posted_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Última"
FROM gold.jobs
WHERE company IS NOT NULL AND last_seen > now() - interval '90 days' AND coalesce(nullif(regions, '{}'), '{other}') && ARRAY[$region]::text[]
  AND company_tier IN ($tier)
  AND ('__all' IN ($role) OR role IN ($role))
  AND ('__all' IN ($seniority) OR seniority IN ($seniority))
  AND ('__all' IN ($company) OR company IN ($company))
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT CASE role WHEN 'product' THEN 'Producto y diseño' WHEN 'eng_management' THEN 'Gestión técnica' WHEN 'ml' THEN 'ML / IA' WHEN 'data' THEN 'Datos' WHEN 'devops' THEN 'DevOps / SRE / Plataforma' WHEN 'security' THEN 'Seguridad' WHEN 'mobile' THEN 'Móvil' WHEN 'qa' THEN 'QA / Test' WHEN 'embedded' THEN 'Embebido / Hardware' WHEN 'fullstack' THEN 'Full-stack' WHEN 'frontend' THEN 'Frontend' WHEN 'backend' THEN 'Backend' WHEN 'engineering' THEN 'Ingeniería (general)' WHEN 'other' THEN 'Otros (no técnicos)' ELSE role END AS "Rol", count(*) AS "Ofertas"
FROM gold.jobs
WHERE last_seen > now() - interval '90 days' AND coalesce(nullif(regions, '{}'), '{other}') && ARRAY[$region]::text[]
  AND company_tier IN ($tier)
  AND ('__all' IN ($role) OR role IN ($role))
  AND ('__all' IN ($seniority) OR seniority IN ($seniority))
  AND ('__all' IN ($company) OR company IN ($company))
GROUP BY role ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Ofertas por nivel
panels.description: Deducido del título. La mayoría de títulos no lo indican.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE seniority WHEN 'intern' THEN 'Prácticas / becario' WHEN 'head' THEN 'Head / dirección' WHEN 'lead' THEN 'Lead / staff / principal' WHEN 'senior' THEN 'Senior' WHEN 'junior' THEN 'Junior' WHEN 'mid' THEN 'Intermedio' WHEN 'unspecified' THEN 'Sin indicar' ELSE seniority END AS "Nivel", count(*) AS "Ofertas"
FROM gold.jobs
WHERE last_seen > now() - interval '90 days' AND coalesce(nullif(regions, '{}'), '{other}') && ARRAY[$region]::text[]
  AND company_tier IN ($tier)
  AND ('__all' IN ($role) OR role IN ($role))
  AND ('__all' IN ($seniority) OR seniority IN ($seniority))
  AND ('__all' IN ($company) OR company IN ($company))
GROUP BY seniority ORDER BY array_position(ARRAY['intern', 'head', 'lead', 'senior', 'junior', 'mid', 'unspecified'], seniority)

panels.title: Big tech con ofertas abiertas
panels.description: Se aplican los filtros de región, rol y nivel; el de empresa no. Las ofertas de FAANG llegan por Adzuna y HN, ver ADR 0009.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT employer AS "Empresa",
       nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE company_tier = 'faang'), 0) AS "FAANG + Microsoft",
       nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE company_tier = 'big_tech'), 0) AS "Big tech"
FROM gold.jobs
WHERE is_open AND company_tier <> 'other'
  AND coalesce(nullif(regions, '{}'), '{other}') && ARRAY[$region]::text[]
  AND ('__all' IN ($role) OR role IN ($role))
  AND ('__all' IN ($seniority) OR seniority IN ($seniority))
GROUP BY employer ORDER BY count(*) DESC, 1 LIMIT 20

panels.title: Últimas ofertas de big tech · clic en el puesto para abrir la oferta

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_char(posted_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Publicada", employer AS "Empresa",
       title AS "Puesto", CASE seniority WHEN 'intern' THEN 'Prácticas / becario' WHEN 'head' THEN 'Head / dirección' WHEN 'lead' THEN 'Lead / staff / principal' WHEN 'senior' THEN 'Senior' WHEN 'junior' THEN 'Junior' WHEN 'mid' THEN 'Intermedio' WHEN 'unspecified' THEN 'Sin indicar' ELSE seniority END AS "Nivel",
       place AS "Lugar", url
FROM gold.jobs
WHERE is_open AND company_tier <> 'other'
  AND coalesce(nullif(regions, '{}'), '{other}') && ARRAY[$region]::text[]
  AND ('__all' IN ($role) OR role IN ($role))
  AND ('__all' IN ($seniority) OR seniority IN ($seniority))
ORDER BY posted_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 200

panels.title: Lo más pedido · % de las ofertas del periodo
panels.description: Sacado del título y la descripción de cada oferta, ver src/jobpipe/tech.py.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t.label AS "Tecnología",
       round(100.0 * count(*) / nullif((SELECT count(*) FROM gold.jobs
                                         WHERE coalesce(nullif(regions, '{}'), '{other}') && ARRAY[$region]::text[]
  AND company_tier IN ($tier)
  AND ('__all' IN ($role) OR role IN ($role))
  AND ('__all' IN ($seniority) OR seniority IN ($seniority))
  AND ('__all' IN ($company) OR company IN ($company)) AND $__timeFilter(posted_at)
                                        ), 0), 1) AS "Ofertas"
FROM gold.jobs p
CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(p.technologies) AS u(key)
JOIN silver.technologies t USING (key)
WHERE coalesce(nullif(regions, '{}'), '{other}') && ARRAY[$region]::text[]
  AND company_tier IN ($tier)
  AND ('__all' IN ($role) OR role IN ($role))
  AND ('__all' IN ($seniority) OR seniority IN ($seniority))
  AND ('__all' IN ($company) OR company IN ($company)) AND $__timeFilter(p.posted_at)
GROUP BY t.label ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 20

panels.title: Porcentaje de ofertas que pide cada tecnología, por mes
panels.description: Se omiten los meses con menos de 10 ofertas. HN llega hasta 2011; las demás fuentes solo tienen lo que estaba abierto al recogerlas.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('month', p.posted_at) AS time, t.label AS metric,
       100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.key = ANY(p.technologies)) / count(*) AS value
FROM gold.jobs p
CROSS JOIN silver.technologies t
WHERE t.key IN ($technology) AND coalesce(nullif(regions, '{}'), '{other}') && ARRAY[$region]::text[]
  AND company_tier IN ($tier)
  AND ('__all' IN ($role) OR role IN ($role))
  AND ('__all' IN ($seniority) OR seniority IN ($seniority))
  AND ('__all' IN ($company) OR company IN ($company)) AND $__timeFilter(p.posted_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING count(*) >= 10 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Ofertas del periodo · clic en el puesto para abrir la oferta

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_char(p.posted_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Publicada",
       coalesce(p.employer, p.company) AS "Empresa", p.title AS "Puesto", CASE role WHEN 'product' THEN 'Producto y diseño' WHEN 'eng_management' THEN 'Gestión técnica' WHEN 'ml' THEN 'ML / IA' WHEN 'data' THEN 'Datos' WHEN 'devops' THEN 'DevOps / SRE / Plataforma' WHEN 'security' THEN 'Seguridad' WHEN 'mobile' THEN 'Móvil' WHEN 'qa' THEN 'QA / Test' WHEN 'embedded' THEN 'Embebido / Hardware' WHEN 'fullstack' THEN 'Full-stack' WHEN 'frontend' THEN 'Frontend' WHEN 'backend' THEN 'Backend' WHEN 'engineering' THEN 'Ingeniería (general)' WHEN 'other' THEN 'Otros (no técnicos)' ELSE role END AS "Rol",
       CASE seniority WHEN 'intern' THEN 'Prácticas / becario' WHEN 'head' THEN 'Head / dirección' WHEN 'lead' THEN 'Lead / staff / principal' WHEN 'senior' THEN 'Senior' WHEN 'junior' THEN 'Junior' WHEN 'mid' THEN 'Intermedio' WHEN 'unspecified' THEN 'Sin indicar' ELSE seniority END AS "Nivel", p.place AS "Lugar", (SELECT string_agg(CASE region WHEN 'ch' THEN 'Suiza' WHEN 'es' THEN 'España' WHEN 'eu' THEN 'Resto de Europa' WHEN 'other' THEN 'Otras / sin región' ELSE region END, ', ') FROM unnest(p.regions) AS r(region)) AS "Región",
       (SELECT string_agg(s.currency || ' ' || round(s.min_annual / 1000) || 'k–' || round(s.max_annual / 1000) || 'k', ' / ')
          FROM gold.salaries s
         WHERE s.job_id = p.job_id AND NOT s.predicted) AS "Salario",
       array_to_string(p.sources, ', ') AS "Fuente", p.url
FROM gold.jobs p
WHERE coalesce(nullif(regions, '{}'), '{other}') && ARRAY[$region]::text[]
  AND company_tier IN ($tier)
  AND ('__all' IN ($role) OR role IN ($role))
  AND ('__all' IN ($seniority) OR seniority IN ($seniority))
  AND ('__all' IN ($company) OR company IN ($company))
  AND $__timeFilter(p.posted_at)
  AND (NOT ${with_salary:raw} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM gold.salaries s WHERE s.job_id = p.job_id AND NOT s.predicted))
ORDER BY 1 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 500
